card.name: Last piece of brand drug names
card.fires_on: The final piece of an uppercase brand drug name split into several parts, such as the Z in REYATAZ or the SO in ELELYSO. It also fires on the end of some rare long names.

modes.label: Brand name endings
modes.description: The last piece of an all-caps brand name in drug label text, right before the text continues.

modes.label: Rare long names
modes.description: The end or middle of a rare anatomical or place name, or a generic drug name.

card.writes: It adds little that is clear; it slightly favors name-ending pieces and odd mixed-language tokens.
card.plain: It lights up on the last letters of a long brand drug name, such as the Z in REYATAZ.
